result.title: From AutoResearch to Continual AutoResearch: Do Agents Learn Across Tasks?
result.summary: Autoresearch has shown that agents can autonomously write code, run experiments, and iteratively improve machine learning solutions. Yet most evaluations start a new agent session from scratch for each new problem, making them costly and leaving unclear whether agents can retain and apply prior insights when adapting to new tasks. We introduce CONTINUAL AUTORESEARCH, an open-ended environment that compares persistent and reset instances of the same agent under matched task streams, data, and time budget. Continual AutoResearch covers nine task families, spanning synthetic tasks, symbolic regression, time-series forecasting, and tabular AutoML. Across five frontier agents, we measure first-solution quality, research efficiency, and final held-out performance. To distinguish insight transfer from session continuity, we run a memory ablation that vary what information agents retain from prior tasks. We show that persistent state improves research efficiency of all five agents, allowing them to find stronger solutions sooner. However, these gains do not consistently translate into better final solutions. Overall, our findings suggest that retaining experience and utilizing it effectively are distinct capabilities.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 CONTINUAL AUTORESEARCH 环境，在匹配的任务流、数据与时间预算下对比同一 agent 的「持续状态」与「重置」两种实例，覆盖九类任务和五个前沿 agent，测量首个解质量、研究效率与最终留出性能，并用记忆消融区分洞见迁移与会话连续性。
AI.relevance_reason: 「保留经验」与「有效利用经验」是两种不同能力这一结论，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态内容是否真被答案使用、以及跨任务状态复用与信息坍缩的评估提供概念参照，但该文不涉及视觉或 latent 推理，迁移线索需核查。
